question: How sensitive are the two main reproduced NK transcript contrasts and all fixed panels to omitting one reported experiment block?
decision: Describe direction and magnitude dependence on each of three blocks without inventing a robustness cutoff; enrichment-ranking sensitivity remains a separate dependent stage.
strongest_rival: A mean transcript difference may depend strongly on one experimental block or pooled-preparation composition.
discriminator: Omit rep1, rep2 and rep3 separately, retain the qualified full-data feature universe, refit the same additive blocked design, and independently calculate balanced within-block differences.
exposure_record: All S1 contrasts and source-panel outputs were inspected before this freeze, including exact concordance and overall source thresholds. This is exposed sensitivity, never confirmation. v1 coefficient calculation completed before this reporting amendment; no direction or magnitude conclusions were inspected before v2 freeze.
biological_unit: Sorted pooled NK preparation/library; reported experimental replicate is a block.
nesting_and_overlap: Nine named libraries; constituent animal IDs, exact pool sizes and cross-assay animal reuse remain unknown. Replicate denotes experiment/day, not repeated mouse.
population_and_selection: All released NK input libraries and features from GSE287581 and pinned author commit 61ac9a440ba3f9db754ff8b8ad5008b450e647c0.
contrast: Source/sample qualification for ITDT minus PBS and ITDT+aCD4 minus ITDT, with the released third contrast retained for later replay.
endpoint: Full and leave-one-block-out transcript coefficients for every retained feature and the fixed published panels.
methods: limma lmFit and contrasts.fit on unchanged S1 log2(TPM+0.5) values and fixed 12,708-feature universe. Each refit has two blocks and six libraries, four design columns and two residual degrees of freedom. Independent NumPy means verify every coefficient within absolute 1e-8. No empirical Bayes P value or new significance testing in this diagnostic.
missingness_and_exclusions: Only the named entire block is omitted per refit; no result-based filtering or extra sources. The initial full-data gene filter is held fixed.
multiplicity: No inferential tests or selected favorable subsets; report all genes and all source panels.
precision_basis: Only three reported blocks and unknown animal membership; source-model P values are reproduced but no new population precision or biological power claim.
interpretation_limit: Reproduction of exposed pooled-library TPM transcript differences; not independent replication, count-based voom reconstruction, NK killing, secretion, signaling or mediation.
stop_rule: Fail sample joins, design rank or independent arithmetic; retain direction reversals and weak patterns without expanding the analysis to obtain a positive result.
amendment_reason: v1 computed and independently checked every coefficient, then failed JSON serialization of a NumPy int64. Preserve v1; v2 reuses its exact numeric output without refitting, converts the count to a native integer, and completes the report and figure.
